name: polyder_product
comment: polyder(a,b) with ONE output is the derivative of the PRODUCT a*b (= polyder(conv(a,b))): polyder([1 0],[1 1])=[2 1], polyder([1 2],[1 3])=[2 5], polyder([1 0 0],[1 1])=[3 2 0]. The TWO-output [q,d] quotient form (q=1, d=[1 2 1]) and the single-arg form (polyder([1 2 3])=[2 2]) are unchanged. bugs/builtin/polyder-product.md.
